🇲🇽💰 <u>4T BIENESTAR REACHES 42.86 MILLION MEXICANS — 1 TRILLION PESOS IN DIRECT TRANSFERS</u>

Welfare Programs hit a historic 42,860,296 beneficiaries in 2026 — over 1 trillion pesos in direct social investment, per Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez. 14.1 million elderly pensions, 3 million women aged 60-64, 2 million people with disabilities, 1.8 million farmers under Producción para el Bienestar. As of May 31, 490 billion pesos already disbursed.

"Por el bien de todos, primero los pobres" isn't a slogan — it's a budget line.

🇲🇽💵 43 PRIVATE-SECTOR ECONOMISTS CUT MEXICO 2026 GDP FORECAST TO 1.09% IN BANXICO POLL — SAME WEEK FDI BROKE A RECORD

Banxico’s monthly specialists survey: 2026 GDP expectation slashed from 1.39% to 1.09%, 2027 down to 1.78%, headline inflation 4.35%, core 4.22% — both above the 3% target. Same window, reinvested foreign profits hit $22.2 billion and Q1 FDI broke the all-time record at $23.591B. The split says what the data always says: domestic demand soft, foreign capital still buying. The growth model is rotating, not collapsing.

🇵🇸🗽 ZOHRAN MAMDANI BECOMES FIRST NYC MAYOR SINCE 1964 TO SKIP THE ISRAEL DAY PARADE

Sixty years of mayoral tradition broken in one decision. “I said on the campaign trail I wouldn’t be attending the parade, and I’ve made my views on the Israeli government abundantly clear,” said Mamdani, who has publicly called the war on Gaza a genocide. His administration still secured the route on Fifth Avenue; the mayor just didn’t march. Decades of forced US municipal genuflection cracked in front of cameras.

🔥🇲🇽 PROFECO LAUNCHES PROCEEDINGS AGAINST STUBHUB AND VIAGOGO — RESELLERS LISTED MUNDIAL TICKETS BEFORE FIFA OPENED SALES

Federal consumer protection agency opens infringement proceedings against the two scalper platforms for violating Article 24 of the Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor — selling tickets before official preventas opened, the textbook definition of “venta especulativa.” Fines could run “varios millones de pesos” and Profeco is studying a criminal complaint. While FIFA prints money, the Mexican state is the only one telling the scalpers to back off.

🇲🇽🏭 EBRARD: MEXICO MUST STOP BEING JUST AN EXPORT MAQUILA — IMPI HIRES 500, AIMS FOR 45% MORE PATENTS BY 2030

The Foreign Ministry’s tech plan: hire 500 new professionals at the Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial, cut patent resolution times, target a 9% increase in industrial property registrations and 45% growth in patents granted to Mexicans by 2030. Ebrard’s frame: “Mexico must move from being an export manufacturing platform to a knowledge and innovation economy” — IP-led sovereignty in the AI era, written into Mexico’s T-MEC strategy.

🇲🇽🏭 MEXICO BREAKS HISTORIC FDI RECORD: $23.591 BILLION IN Q1 2026, +10.4% YoY

Secretaría de Economía data: reinvested profits jumped 33.5% to $22.222B — capital already inside Mexico choosing to stay and grow. Construction investment exploded 96.3%, transport/logistics +123%, computing/electronics +58.7%, mining +39.7%, autos +20.4%. US sent $10.21B (+23.3%), Spain $3.804B (+18.5%), Australia $1.446B. The “Mexico is unstable” narrative collides with the cashflow.

🇲🇽💵 APRIL REMITTANCES HIT $4.978B — 3.7% YoY GROWTH IS THE SAME PEOPLE SENDING MORE, NOT NEW PEOPLE SENDING

Banxico reports 12.4 million transactions in April, 1.7% FEWER than 2025 — but each averaged $403, up 5.5%. The same migrants are sending more per transfer to compensate for everyone who got deported. January–April closed at $19.676 billion, 2.6% above the same period last year. Mexico’s working class abroad is absorbing Trump’s ICE pressure on the family books, not the macro books.
📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — 1 de junio de 2026 · Palacio Nacional
